description: NaYF₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pc space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.36 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.45 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.54 Å. There are three inequivalent Y sites. In the first Y site, Y is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Y-F bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.36 Å. In the second Y site, Y is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Y-F bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.36 Å. In the third Y site, Y is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Y-F bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.36 Å. There are twelve inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two Na and two Y atoms to form FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra that share corners with fifteen FNaY₃ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with five FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramid. In the second F site, F is bonded to one Na and three Y atoms to form FNaY₃ tetrahedra that share corners with fifteen FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra, corners with two FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with four FNaY₃ tetrahedra, and edges with two FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramids. In the third F site, F is bonded to one Na and three Y atoms to form FNaY₃ tetrahedra that share corners with thirteen FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra, corners with four FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramids, and edges with six FNaY₃ tetrahedra. In the fourth F site, F is bonded to two Na and two Y atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra. In the fifth F site, F is bonded to two Na and two Y atoms to form distorted FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with fifteen FNaY₃ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with five FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramid. In the sixth F site, F is bonded to two Na and two Y atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra. In the seventh F site, F is bonded to one Na and three Y atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNaY₃ tetrahedra. In the eighth F site, F is bonded to two Na and two Y atoms to form FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra that share corners with fifteen FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra, corners with two FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with four FNaY₃ tetrahedra, and edges with two FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramids. In the ninth F site, F is bonded to two Na and two Y atoms to form FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra that share corners with thirteen FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra, corners with four FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with four FNaY₃ tetrahedra, and edges with two FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramids. In the tenth F site, F is bonded to two Na and two Y atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra. In the eleventh F site, F is bonded to two Na and two Y atoms to form distorted FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with fifteen FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with five FNaY₃ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramid. In the twelfth F site, F is bonded to two Na and two Y atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra.
